items.title: American Express’ Q2 Revenue Miss Versus Peers Might Change The Case For Investing In AXP
items.summary: In Q2, American Express reported revenue of US$18.55 billion, up 12.8% year on year but about 5.8% below analyst expectations, making it the weakest performer versus estimates among major credit card peers that largely exceeded forecasts. This miss, contrasted with stronger revenue and earnings results from competitors such as Visa, Mastercard, Synchrony Financial, and Bread Financial, highlights how relative underperformance against sector peers can heavily influence how markets interpret...

items.title: How Berkshire’s New CEO Plans to Protect Iowa Power Costs From Hyperscaler Data Center Expansion
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway  CEO Greg Abel said the company will only provide power for new data centers if other utility customers benefit.  In a wide-ranging interview Wednesday morning with CNBC from Tokyo—where Abel is visiting with several large Japanese trading companies in which Berkshire has investments—the CEO discussed how Berkshire’s big utility, Berkshire Hathaway Energy, approaches data centers.
